🔹 Description (long)

Weather Cycler is a lightweight Fabric mod that lets you control weather and time in Survival and Hardcore worlds — without commands.

Everything is done using craftable items, balanced with durability, cooldowns, and Netherite upgrades to keep gameplay fair and vanilla-friendly.

✨ Features
🌦 Weather Cycler

Cycles between:

Clear weather

Rain

Thunderstorm

Visual particle feedback for each weather type

Sound and actionbar message on use

100 uses (durability-based)

10s cooldown

⏰ Time Cycler

Cycles through:

Dawn

Day

Noon

Sunset

Night

Midnight

Unique particles for each time state

100 uses

10s cooldown

🔥 Netherite Upgrade

Upgrade both items using crafting:

Weather Cycler + Netherite Ingot

Time Cycler + Netherite Ingot

Upgraded version benefits:

200 uses

50% reduced cooldown

Weather lasts longer (Weather Cycler)

🛠 Balance & Design

No commands required

Works in Hardcore

Server-safe (logic runs server-side)

Fully compatible with Fabric API

Vanilla-style particles and sounds

No configuration needed

🔹 Dependencies

Fabric Loader

Fabric API

🔹 Game Versions

Minecraft 1.21.5

🔹 Mod Loaders

Fabric
